definitions.explanation: Viewing or photographing distant objects using lenses or optical equipment. Composed of 望 (gaze/hope) + 遠 (distant). Most commonly used in compound words related to optics and photography.

examples.japanese: {望遠|ぼうえん}レンズで{鳥|とり}を{撮影|さつえい}した。
examples.english: I photographed birds with a telephoto lens.

examples.japanese: {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう}で{月|つき}の{表面|ひょうめん}を{観察|かんさつ}した。
examples.english: I observed the surface of the moon with a telescope.

examples.japanese: スマホのカメラにも{望遠|ぼうえん}{機能|きのう}が{付|つ}いている{機種|きしゅ}がある。
examples.english: Some smartphone models have a telephoto camera function.

notes:
USAGE:
{望遠|ぼうえん} is most commonly encountered in compound words rather than used alone. The two most important compounds are {望遠|ぼうえん}レンズ (telephoto lens) and {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう} (telescope).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {望遠|ぼうえん}レンズ (telephoto lens)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう} (telescope)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}{撮影|さつえい} (telephoto photography)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}{機能|きのう} (telephoto function)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{広角|こうかく} (wide-angle) is the opposite concept in photography. {遠望|えんぼう} means 'distant view' but refers to looking at a faraway landscape rather than using optical equipment.
